title: MCP describe_object lists the hidden __search companion field (both transports)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cw787kMeaX7oyz7DDC

Found while fixing #33338 (PR #33451, which only drops the companion from `validate_expression`'s `inScope.fields`). Measured, not inferred: before that fix, the failing pin received `__search` from this producer's output.

## Line

MCP `describe_object` on an object with field-scoped search · both MCP transports · every caller that introspects such an object · measured.

`describeServedObject` (`packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`, and its twin in `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`) passes every served field through. So `describe_object` lists the hidden `__search` companion column (marked readonly/system) that the registry adds for field-scoped search. The checklist item `search.field-scoped-narrowing` A2 says that field is invisible, and after #33451 `validate_expression` refuses a read of it with `unknown-field`. An agent reading `describe_object` is therefore offered a field that every other door refuses.

## Do

- Skip `SEARCH_COMPANION_FIELD` (objectql's own constant, the one #33451 reuses) in `describeServedObject` on both transports. Do not add a second list. If the two twins can share one helper, prefer that.
- Pin it on both transports: a field-scoped search object's `describe_object` answer has no `__search`, and ordinary fields plus the platform's other system columns (`organization_id`, etc.) are still listed. Ablate.

Reader who acts: `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`.
Suggested grade: p2 (wrong information to the caller, no data written), raised once for MCP focus → p1, the same reading as #33338. Lane: `domain:server`.
